answer: Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The beacon panel is drawn blind, the wharf escrow settles at close, and mirror lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 14% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 426 account operation therefore ties up 23 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
